crossRefs.note: This woman’s child died in the night, because she lay on it.

translations.web: This woman’s child died in the night, because she lay on it.
translations.bsb: During the night this woman’s son died because she rolled over on him.
translations.kjv: And this woman's child died in the night; because she overlaid it.
translations.asv: And this woman's child died in the night, because she lay upon it.
